documents.original:
सहस्रशीर्षा पुरुषः सहस्राक्षः सहस्रपात् ।
स भूमिं विश्वतो वृत्वात्यतिष्ठद्दशाङ्गुलम् ॥ १ ॥
documents.transliteration:
sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt |
sa bhūmiṃ viśvato vṛtvātyatiṣṭhaddaśāṅgulam || 1 ||
documents.text:
A thousand heads hath Puruṣa, a thousand eyes, a thousand feet.
On every side pervading earth he fills a space ten fingers wide.

documents.original:
पुरुष एवेदं सर्वं यद्भूतं यच्च भव्यम् ।
उतामृतत्वस्येशानो यदन्नेनातिरोहति ॥ २ ॥
documents.transliteration:
puruṣa evedaṃ sarvaṃ yadbhūtaṃ yacca bhavyam |
utāmṛtatvasyeśāno yadannenātirohati || 2 ||
documents.text:
This Puruṣa is all that yet hath been and all that is to be;
The Lord of immortality which waxes greater still by food.

documents.original:
एतावानस्य महिमातो ज्यायांश्च पूरुषः ।
पादोऽस्य विश्वा भूतानि त्रिपादस्यामृतं दिवि ॥ ३ ॥
documents.transliteration:
etāvānasya mahimāto jyāyāṃśca pūruṣaḥ |
pādo'sya viśvā bhūtāni tripādasyāmṛtaṃ divi || 3 ||
documents.text:
So mighty is his greatness; yea, greater than this is Puruṣa.
All creatures are one-fourth of him, three-fourths eternal life in heaven.

documents.original:
त्रिपादू pieceर्ध्व उदैत्पुरुषः पादोऽस्येहाभवत्पुनः ।
ततो विष्वङ् व्यक्रामत्साशनानशने अभि ॥ ४ ॥
documents.transliteration:
tripādū piecerdhva udaitpuruṣaḥ pādo'syehābhavatpunaḥ |
tato viṣvaṅ vyakrāmatsāśanānaśane abhi || 4 ||
documents.text:
With three-fourths Puruṣa went up: one-fourth of him again was here.
Thence he strode out to every side over what eats and what eats not.

documents.original:
तस्माद्विराळजायत विराजो अधि पूरुषः ।
स जातो अत्यरिच्यत पश्चाद्भूमिमथो पुरः ॥ ५ ॥
documents.transliteration:
tasmādvirāḻajāyata virājo adhi pūruṣaḥ |
sa jāto atyaricyata paścādbhūmimatho puraḥ || 5 ||
documents.text:
From him Virāj was born; again Puruṣa from Virāj was born.
As soon as he was born he spread eastward and westward o’er the earth.

documents.original:
यत्पुरुषेण हविषा देवा यज्ञमतन्वता ।
वसन्तो अस्यासीदाज्यं ग्रीष्म इध्मः शरद्धविः ॥ ६ ॥
documents.transliteration:
yatpuruṣeṇa haviṣā devā yajñamatanvatā |
vasanto asyāsīdājyaṃ grīṣma idhmaḥ śaraddhaviḥ || 6 ||
documents.text:
When Gods prepared the sacrifice with Puruṣa as their offering,
Its oil was spring, the holy gift was autumn, summer was the wood.

documents.original:
तं यज्ञं बर्हिषि प्रौक्षन्पुरुषं जातमग्रतः ।
तेन देवा अयजन्त साध्या ऋषयश्च ये ॥ ७ ॥
documents.transliteration:
taṃ yajñaṃ barhiṣi praukṣanpuruṣaṃ jātamagrataḥ |
tena devā ayajanta sādhyā ṛṣayaśca ye || 7 ||
documents.text:
They balmed as sacrifice on holy grass the Puruṣa born when time began.
With him the deities and all Sādhyas and Ṛṣis made sacrifice.

documents.original:
तस्माद्यज्ञात्सर्वहुतः संभृतं पृषदाज्यम् ।
पशून्तांश्चक्रे वायव्यानारण्यान ग्राम्याश्च ये ॥ ८ ॥
documents.transliteration:
tasmādyajñātsarvahutaḥ saṃbhṛtaṃ pṛṣadājyam |
paśūntāṃścakre vāyavyānāraṇyāna grāmyāśca ye || 8 ||
documents.text:
From that great general sacrifice the drippings of the fat were gathered.
He formed the creatures of-the air, and animals both wild and tame.

documents.original:
तस्माद्यज्ञात्सर्वहुत ऋचः सामानि जज्ञिरे ।
छन्दांसि जज्ञिरे तस्माद्यजुस्तस्मादजायत ॥ ९ ॥
documents.transliteration:
tasmādyajñātsarvahuta ṛcaḥ sāmāni jajñire |
chandāṃsi jajñire tasmādyajustasmādajāyata || 9 ||
documents.text:
From that great general sacrifice Ṛcas and Sāma-hymns were produced:
Therefrom were spells and charms produced; the Yajus had its birth from it.

documents.original:
तस्मादश्वा अजायन्त ये के चोभयादतः ।
गावो ह जज्ञिरे तस्मात्तस्माज्जाता अजावयः ॥ १० ॥
documents.transliteration:
tasmādaśvā ajāyanta ye ke cobhayādataḥ |
gāvo ha jajñire tasmāttasmājjātā ajāvayaḥ || 10 ||
documents.text:
From it were horses born, from it all cattle with two rows of teeth:
From it were generated kine, from it the goats and sheep were born.

documents.original:
यत्पुरुषं व्यदधुः कतिधा व्यकल्पयन् ।
मुखं किमस्य कौ बाहू का ऊरू पादा उच्येते ॥ ११ ॥
documents.transliteration:
yatpuruṣaṃ vyadadhuḥ katidhā vyakalpayan |
mukhaṃ kimasya kau bāhū kā ūrū pādā ucyete || 11 ||
documents.text:
When they divided Puruṣa how many portions did they make?
What do they call his mouth, his arms? What do they call his thighs and feet?

documents.original:
ब्राह्मणोऽस्य मुखमासीद्बाहू राजन्यः कृतः ।
ऊरू तदस्य यद्वैश्यः पद्भ्यां शूद्रो अजायत ॥ १२ ॥
documents.transliteration:
brāhmaṇo'sya mukhamāsīdbāhū rājanyaḥ kṛtaḥ |
ūrū tadasya yadvaiśyaḥ padbhyāṃ śūdro ajāyata || 12 ||
documents.text:
The Brāhmaṇa was his mouth, of both his arms was the Rājanya made.
His thighs became the Vaiśya, from his feet the Śūdra was produced.

documents.original:
चन्द्रमा मनसो जातश्चक्षोः सूर्यो अजायत ।
मुखादिन्द्रश्चाग्निश्च प्राणाद्वायुरजायत ॥ १३ ॥
documents.transliteration:
candramā manaso jātaścakṣoḥ sūryo ajāyata |
mukhādindraścāgniśca prāṇādvāyurajāyata || 13 ||
documents.text:
The Moon was gendered from his mind, and from his eye the Sun had birth;
Indra and Agni from his mouth were born, and Vāyu from his breath.

documents.original:
नाभ्या आसीदन्तरिक्षं शीर्ष्णो द्यौः समवर्तत ।
पद्भ्यां भूमिर्दिशः श्रोत्रात्तथा लोकाँ अकल्पयन् ॥ १४ ॥
documents.transliteration:
nābhyā āsīdantarikṣaṃ śīrṣṇo dyauḥ samavartata |
padbhyāṃ bhūmirdiśaḥ śrotrāttathā lokā~ akalpayan || 14 ||
documents.text:
Forth from his navel came mid-air the sky was fashioned from his head
Earth from his feet, and from his ear the regions. Thus they formed the worlds.

documents.original:
सप्तास्यासन्परिधयस्त्रिः सप्त समिधः कृताः ।
देवा यद्यज्ञं तन्वाना अबध्नन्पुरुषं पशुम् ॥ १५ ॥
documents.transliteration:
saptāsyāsanparidhayastriḥ sapta samidhaḥ kṛtāḥ |
devā yadyajñaṃ tanvānā abadhnanpuruṣaṃ paśum || 15 ||
documents.text:
Seven fencing-sticks had he, thrice seven layers of fuel were prepared,
When the Gods, offering sacrifice, bound, as their victim, Puruṣa.

documents.original:
यज्ञेन यज्ञमयजन्त देवास्तानि धर्माणि प्रथमान्यासन् ।
ते ह नाकं महिमानः सचन्त यत्र पूर्वे साध्याः सन्ति देवाः ॥ १६ ॥
documents.transliteration:
yajñena yajñamayajanta devāstāni dharmāṇi prathamānyāsan |
te ha nākaṃ mahimānaḥ sacanta yatra pūrve sādhyāḥ santi devāḥ || 16 ||
documents.text:
Gods, sacrificing, sacrificed the victim these were the earliest holy ordinances.
The mighty ones attained the height of heaven, there where the Sādhyas, Gods of old, are dwelling.

documents.original:
नासदासीन्नो सदासीत्तदानीं नासीद्रजो नो व्योमा परो यत् ।
किमावरीवः कुह कस्य शर्मन्नम्भः किमासीद्गहनं गभीरम् ॥ १ ॥
documents.transliteration:
nāsadāsīnno sadāsīttadānīṃ nāsīdrajo no vyomā paro yat |
kimāvarīvaḥ kuha kasya śarmannambhaḥ kimāsīdgahanaṃ gabhīram || 1 ||
documents.text:
Then was not non-existent nor existent: there was no realm of air, no sky beyond it.
What covered in, and where? and what gave shelter? Was water there, unfathomed depth of water?

documents.original:
न मृत्युरासीदमृतं न तर्हि न रात्र्या अह्न आसीत्प्रकेतः ।
आनीदवातं स्वधया तदेकं तस्माद्धान्यन्न परः किञ्चनास ॥ २ ॥
documents.transliteration:
na mṛtyurāsīdamṛtaṃ na tarhi na rātryā ahna āsītpraketaḥ |
ānīdavātaṃ svadhayā tadekaṃ tasmāddhānyanna paraḥ kiñcanāsa || 2 ||
documents.text:
Death was not then, nor was there aught immortal: no sign was there, the day's and night's divider.
That One Thing, breathless, breathed by its own nature: apart from it was nothing whatsoever.

documents.original:
तम आसीत्तमसा गूळ्हमग्रेऽप्रकेतं सलिलं सर्वमा इदम् ।
तुच्छ्येनाभ्वपिहितं यदासीत्तपसस्तन्महिनाजायतैकम् ॥ ३ ॥
documents.transliteration:
tama āsīttamasā gūḻhamagre'praketaṃ salilaṃ sarvamā idam |
tucchyenābhvapihitaṃ yadāsīttapasastanmahinājāyataikam || 3 ||
documents.text:
Darkness there was: at first concealed in darkness this All was undiscriminated chaos.
All that existed then was void and formless: by the great power of Warmth was born that Unit.

documents.original:
कामस्तदग्रे समवर्तताधि मनसो रेतः प्रथमं यदासीत् ।
सतो बन्धुमसति निरविन्दन्हृदि प्रतीष्या कवयो मनीषा ॥ ४ ॥
documents.transliteration:
kāmastadagre samavartatādhi manaso retaḥ prathamaṃ yadāsīt |
sato bandhumasati niravindanhṛdi pratīṣyā kavayo manīṣā || 4 ||
documents.text:
Thereafter rose Desire in the beginning, Desire, the primal seed and germ of Spirit.
Sages who searched with their heart's thought discovered the existent's kinship in the non-existent.

documents.original:
तिरश्चीनो विततो रश्मिरेषामधः स्विदासीदुपरि स्विदासीत् ।
रेतोधा आसन्महिमान आसन्त्स्वधा अवस्तात्प्रयतिः परस्तात् ॥ ५ ॥
documents.transliteration:
tiraścīno vitato raśmireṣāmadhaḥ svidāsīdupari svidāsīt |
retodhā āsanmahimāna āsantsvadhā avastātprayatiḥ parastāt || 5 ||
documents.text:
Crosswise was severed their dividing line: was aught above it, and was aught below it?
There were begetters, there were mighty forces, free action here and energy up yonder.

documents.original:
को अद्धा वेद क इह प्र वोचत्कुत आजाता कुत इयं विसृष्टिः ।
अर्वाग्देवा अस्य विसर्जनेनाथा को वेद यत आबभूव ॥ ६ ॥
documents.transliteration:
ko addhā veda ka iha pra vocatkuta ājātā kuta iyaṃ visṛṣṭiḥ |
arvāgdevā asya visarjanenāthā ko veda yata ābabhūva || 6 ||
documents.text:
Who verily knows and who can here declare it, whence it was born and whence comes this creation?
The Gods are later than this world's production. Who knows then whence it first came into being?

documents.original:
इयं विसृष्टिर्यत आबभूव यदि वा दधे यदि वा न ।
यो अस्याध्यक्षः परमे व्योमन्त्सो अङ्ग वेद यदि वा न वेद ॥ ७ ॥
documents.transliteration:
iyaṃ visṛṣṭiryata ābabhūva yadi vā dadhe yadi vā na |
yo asyādhyakṣaḥ parame vyomantso aṅga veda yadi vā na veda || 7 ||
documents.text:
He, the first origin of this creation, whether he formed it all or did not form it,
Whose eye controls this world in highest heaven, he verily knows it, or perhaps he knows not.

documents.original:
हिरण्यवर्णां हरिणीं सुवर्णरजतस्रजाम् ।
चन्द्रां हिरण्मयीं लक्ष्मीं जातवेदो म आवह ॥ १ ॥
documents.transliteration:
hiraṇyavarṇāṃ hariṇīṃ suvarṇarajatasrajām |
candrāṃ hiraṇmayīṃ lakṣmīṃ jātavedo ma āvaha || 1 ||
documents.text: Invoke for me, O Agni, that Lakshmi of golden hue, radiant like gold, bedecked with garlands of silver and gold, brilliant as the moon and embodiment of fortune.

documents.original:
तां म आवह जातवेदो लक्ष्मीमनपगामिनीम् ।
यस्यां हिरण्यं विन्देयं गामश्वं पुरुषानहम् ॥ २ ॥
documents.transliteration:
tāṃ ma āvaha jātavedo lakṣmīmanapagāminīm |
yasyāṃ hiraṇyaṃ vindeyaṃ gāmaśvaṃ puruṣānaham || 2 ||
documents.text: Invoke for me, O Agni, that Lakshmi who never departs, through whose grace I may attain gold, kine, horses, and virtuous companions.

documents.original:
अश्वपूर्वां रथमध्यां हस्तिनादप्रबोधिनीम् ।
श्रियं देवीमुपह्वये श्रीर्मा देवी जुषताम् ॥ ३ ॥
documents.transliteration:
aśvapūrvāṃ rathamadhyāṃ hastinādaprabodhinīm |
śriyaṃ devīmupahvaye śrīrmā devī juṣatām || 3 ||
documents.text: Preceded by horses, riding in the midst of chariots, awakened by the trumpet of majestic elephants, I invoke that divine Sri. May the Goddess be gracious unto me.

documents.original:
कां सोस्मितां हिरण्यप्राकारामार्द्रां ज्वलन्तीं तृप्तां तर्पयन्तीम् ।
पद्मे स्थितां पद्मवर्णां तामिहोपह्वये श्रियम् ॥ ४ ॥
documents.transliteration:
kāṃ sosmitāṃ hiraṇyaprākārāmārdrāṃ jvalantīṃ tṛptāṃ tarpayantīm |
padme sthitāṃ padmavarṇāṃ tāmihopahvaye śriyam || 4 ||
documents.text: She who possesses a gentle smile, enclosed within radiant golden ramparts, ever blissful, glowing, satisfied and granting satisfaction, dwelling upon the lotus, lotus-hued, I invoke that Sri.

documents.original:
चन्द्रां प्रभासां यशसा ज्वलन्तीं श्रियं लोके देवजुष्टामुदाराम् ।
तां पद्मिनीमीं शरणमहं प्रपद्येऽलक्ष्मीर्मे नश्यतां त्वां वृणे ॥ ५ ॥
documents.transliteration:
candrāṃ prabhāsāṃ yaśasā jvalantīṃ śriyaṃ loke devajuṣṭāmudārām |
tāṃ padminīmīṃ śaraṇamahaṃ prapadye'lakṣmīrme naśyatāṃ tvāṃ vṛṇe || 5 ||
documents.text: Shining like the moon, glowing with auspicious splendor, adored by the celestials, noble and generous, I take refuge in that Lotus Goddess. May adversity vanish; I seek Your shelter.

documents.original:
आदित्यवर्णे तपसोऽधिजातो वनस्पतिस्तव वृक्षोऽथ बिल्वः ।
तस्य फलानि तपसानुदन्तु मायान्तरायाश्च बाह्या अलक्ष्मीः ॥ ६ ॥
documents.transliteration:
ādityavarṇe tapaso'dhijāto vanaspatistava vṛkṣo'tha bilvaḥ |
tasya phalāni tapasānudantu māyāntarāyāśca bāhyā alakṣmīḥ || 6 ||
documents.text: O Goddess radiant like the sun, through your intense penance was born the Bilva tree, sacred king of trees. May its holy fruits dispel the inner darkness of ignorance and outer poverty.

documents.original:
उपैतु मां देवसखः कीर्तिश्च मणिना सह ।
प्रादुर्भूतोऽस्मि राष्ट्रेऽस्मिन् कीर्तिमृद्धिं ददातु मे ॥ ७ ॥
documents.transliteration:
upaitu māṃ devasakhaḥ kīrtiśca maṇinā saha |
prādurbhūto'smi rāṣṭre'smin kīrtimṛddhiṃ dadātu me || 7 ||
documents.text: May the friend of the celestials Kubera, and Fame along with the wishing-jewel, come unto me. Born in this sacred land, bestow upon me lasting fame and prosperity.

documents.original:
क्षुत्पिपासामलां ज्येष्ठामलक्ष्मीं नाशयाम्यहम् ।
अभूतिमसमृद्धिं च सर्वान् निर्णुद मे गृहात् ॥ ८ ॥
documents.transliteration:
kṣutpipāsāmalāṃ jyeṣṭhāmalakṣmīṃ nāśayāmyaham |
abhūtimasamṛddhiṃ ca sarvān nirṇuda me gṛhāt || 8 ||
documents.text: I dispel the eldest misfortune, hunger and thirst and filth. O Mother, banish from my home all distress, decay, and lack of spiritual and material abundance.

documents.original:
गन्धद्वारां दुराधर्षां नित्यपुष्टां करीषिणीम् ।
ईश्वरीं सर्वभूतानां तामिहोपह्वये श्रियम् ॥ ९ ॥
documents.transliteration:
gandhadvārāṃ durādharṣāṃ nityapuṣṭāṃ karīṣiṇīm |
īśvarīṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ tāmihopahvaye śriyam || 9 ||
documents.text: Approached through fragrant aroma, invincible, eternally thriving, rich in fertile harvest and cattle, the sovereign ruler of all beings, I invoke that Sri.

documents.original:
मनसः काममाकूतिं वाचः सत्यमशीमहि ।
पशूनां रूपमन्नस्य मयि श्रीः श्रयतां यशः ॥ १० ॥
documents.transliteration:
manasaḥ kāmamākūtiṃ vācaḥ satyamaśīmahi |
paśūnāṃ rūpamannasya mayi śrīḥ śrayatāṃ yaśaḥ || 10 ||
documents.text: May the sincere aspirations of my heart, the truth of speech, the beauty of living herds, and the abundance of food dwell within me; may glory and spiritual majesty abide.

documents.original:
कर्दमेन प्रजाभूता मयि सम्भव कर्दम ।
श्रियं वासय मे कुले मातरं पद्ममालिनीम् ॥ ११ ॥
documents.transliteration:
kardamena prajābhūtā mayi sambhava kardama |
śriyaṃ vāsaya me kule mātaraṃ padmamālinīm || 11 ||
documents.text: Through Kardama Prajapati you have progeny. Dwell in me, O Kardama, and cause the Mother Sri, crowned with lotus garlands, to dwell forever in our lineage.

documents.original:
आपः सृजन्तु स्निग्धानि चिक्लीत वस मे गृहे ।
नि च देवीं मातरं श्रियं वासय मे कुले ॥ १२ ॥
documents.transliteration:
āpaḥ sṛjantu snigdhāni ciklīta vasa me gṛhe |
ni ca devīṃ mātaraṃ śriyaṃ vāsaya me kule || 12 ||
documents.text: May the waters create pure loving harmony. O Chiklita, dwell within my home, and establish the Divine Mother Sri permanently in our family.

documents.original:
आर्द्रां पुष्करिणीं पुष्टिं पिङ्गलां पद्ममालिनीम् ।
चन्द्रां हिरण्मयीं लक्ष्मीं जातवेदो म आवह ॥ १३ ॥
documents.transliteration:
ārdrāṃ puṣkariṇīṃ puṣṭiṃ piṅgalāṃ padmamālinīm |
candrāṃ hiraṇmayīṃ lakṣmīṃ jātavedo ma āvaha || 13 ||
documents.text: Invoke for me, O Agni, that Mother who is compassionate, endowed with the waters of life, the embodiment of sustenance, golden-hued, garlanded with lotuses, radiant as the moon.

documents.original:
आर्द्रां यः करिणीं यष्टिं सुवर्णां हेममालिनीम् ।
सूर्यां हिरण्मयीं लक्ष्मीं जातवेदो म आवह ॥ १४ ॥
documents.transliteration:
ārdrāṃ yaḥ kariṇīṃ yaṣṭiṃ suvarṇāṃ hemamālinīm |
sūryāṃ hiraṇmayīṃ lakṣmīṃ jātavedo ma āvaha || 14 ||
documents.text: Invoke for me, O Agni, that Mother who holds the royal scepter of dharma, golden-hued, adorned with golden garlands, dazzling as the sun.

documents.original:
यः शुचिः प्रयतो भूत्वा जुहुयादाज्यमन्वहम् ।
श्रियः पञ्चदशर्चं च श्रीकामः सततं जपेत् ॥ १५ ॥
documents.transliteration:
yaḥ śuciḥ prayato bhūtvā juhuyādājyamanvaham |
śriyaḥ pañcadaśarcaṃ ca śrīkāmaḥ satataṃ japet || 15 ||
documents.text: Whosoever, purified and devoted, offers daily oblations of clarified butter and recites these fifteen sacred verses desiring spiritual and material well-being, attains the perpetual grace of Sri.

documents.original:
ॐ पूर्णमदः पूर्णमिदं पूर्णात्पूर्णमुदच्यते ।
पूर्णस्य पूर्णमादाय पूर्णमेवावशिष्यते ॥
ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः ॥
documents.transliteration:
oṃ pūrṇamadaḥ pūrṇamidaṃ pūrṇātpūrṇamudacyate |
pūrṇasya pūrṇamādāya pūrṇamevāvaśiṣyate ||
oṃ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ ||
documents.text:
That is Infinite, this is Infinite; from the Infinite proceeds the Infinite.
Taking the Infinite from the Infinite, the Infinite alone remains.
Om Peace, Peace, Peace.

documents.original:
ॐ सह नाववतु । सह नौ भुनक्तु ।
सह वीर्यं करवावहै ।
तेजस्वि नावधीतमस्तु मा विद्विषावहै ॥
ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः ॥
documents.transliteration:
oṃ saha nāvavatu | saha nau bhunaktu |
saha vīryaṃ karavāvahai |
tejasvi nāvadhītamastu mā vidviṣāvahai ||
oṃ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ ||

documents.original:
ॐ असतो मा सद्गमय । तमसो मा ज्योतिर्गमय ।
मृत्योर्मा अमृतं गमय ॥
ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः ॥
documents.transliteration:
oṃ asato mā sadgamaya | tamaso mā jyotirgamaya |
mṛtyormā amṛtaṃ gamaya ||
oṃ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ ||
documents.text:
Lead me from the unreal to the Real.
Lead me from darkness to Light.
Lead me from death to Immortality.
Om Peace, Peace, Peace.

documents.original:
ॐ शं नो मित्रः शं वरुणः । शं नो भवत्वर्यमा ।
शं न इन्द्रो बृहस्पतिः । शं नो विष्णुरुरुक्रमः ॥
ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः ॥
documents.transliteration:
oṃ śaṃ no mitraḥ śaṃ varuṇaḥ | śaṃ no bhavatvaryamā |
śaṃ na indro bṛhaspatiḥ | śaṃ no viṣṇururukramaḥ ||
oṃ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ ||

documents.original:
ॐ भद्रं कर्णेभिः शृणुयाम देवाः ।
भद्रं पश्येमाक्षभिर्यजत्राः ।
स्थिरैरङ्गैस्तुष्टुवांसस्तनूभिः ।
व्यशेम देवहितं यदायुः ॥
ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः ॥
documents.transliteration:
oṃ bhadraṃ karṇebhiḥ śṛṇuyāma devāḥ |
bhadraṃ paśyemākṣabhiryajatrāḥ |
sthirairaṅgaistuṣṭuvāṃsastanūbhiḥ |
vyaśema devahitaṃ yadāyuḥ ||
oṃ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ ||
documents.text:
May we, O Devas, hear with our ears what is auspicious.
May we, who are worthy of worship, see with our eyes what is auspicious.
With limbs and body firm and singing praises unto you, may we enjoy the full span of life decreed by the divine.
Om Peace, Peace, Peace.

documents.original:
ॐ द्यौः शान्तिरन्तरिक्षं शान्तिः पृथिवी शान्तिरापः शान्तिरोषधयः शान्तिः ।
वनस्पतयः शान्तिर्विश्वेदेवाः शान्तिर्ब्रह्म शान्तिः सर्वं शान्तिः शान्तिरेव शान्तिः सा मा शान्तिरेधि ॥
ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः ॥
documents.transliteration:
oṃ dyauḥ śāntirantarikṣaṃ śāntiḥ pṛthivī śāntirāpaḥ śāntiroṣadhayaḥ śāntiḥ |
vanaspatayaḥ śāntirviśvedevāḥ śāntirbrahma śāntiḥ sarvaṃ śāntiḥ śāntireva śāntiḥ sā mā śāntiredhi ||
oṃ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ ||
documents.text:
May there be peace in heaven, peace in the atmosphere, peace on earth, peace in the waters, peace in herbs and plants.
May there be peace in all divine beings, peace in Brahman, peace everywhere; peace alone peace; may that true peace abide within me.
Om Peace, Peace, Peace.

documents.original:
ॐ सर्वे भवन्तु सुखिनः सर्वे सन्तु निरामयाः ।
सर्वे भद्राणि पश्यन्तु मा कश्चिद्दुःखभाग्भवेत् ॥
ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः ॥
documents.transliteration:
oṃ sarve bhavantu sukhinaḥ sarve santu nirāmayāḥ |
sarve bhadrāṇi paśyantu mā kaścidduḥkhabhāgbhavet ||
oṃ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ ||
documents.text:
May all beings be happy; may all beings be free from illness.
May all behold what is good and auspicious; may no one suffer any sorrow.
Om Peace, Peace, Peace.

documents.original:
ॐ वाङ् मे मनसि प्रतिष्ठिता मनो मे वाचि प्रतिष्ठितम् ।
आविरावीर्म एधि वेदस्य म आणीस्थः श्रुतं मे मा प्रहासीः ॥
ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः ॥
documents.transliteration:
oṃ vāṅ me manasi pratiṣṭhitā mano me vāci pratiṣṭhitam |
āvirāvīrma edhi vedasya ma āṇīsthaḥ śrutaṃ me mā prahāsīḥ ||
oṃ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ ||
documents.text:
May my speech be established in my mind; may my mind be established in my speech.
O Divine Self, reveal Thyself to me; may speech and mind bring me the truths of the Veda; may what I have heard never depart from me.
Om Peace, Peace, Peace.

documents.original:
ॐ आप्यायन्तु ममाङ्गानि वाक्प्राणश्चक्षुः श्रोत्रमथो बलमिन्द्रियाणि च सर्वाणि ।
सर्वं ब्रह्मौपनिषदं माहं ब्रह्म निराकुर्यां मा मा ब्रह्म निराकरोत् ॥
ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः ॥
documents.transliteration:
oṃ āpyāyantu mamāṅgāni vākprāṇaścakṣuḥ śrotramatho balamindriyāṇi ca sarvāṇi |
sarvaṃ brahmaupaniṣadaṃ māhaṃ brahma nirākuryāṃ mā mā brahma nirākarot ||
oṃ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ ||
documents.text:
May my limbs, speech, vital energy, eyes, ears, and strength of all senses grow strong.
All is the Brahman of the Upaniṣads; may I never deny Brahman, and may Brahman never reject me.
Om Peace, Peace, Peace.

documents.original:
ॐ नमो ब्रह्मणे । नमस्ते वायो ।
त्वमेव प्रत्यक्षं ब्रह्मासि । त्वामेव प्रत्यक्षं ब्रह्म वदिष्यामि ।
ऋतं वदिष्यामि । सत्यं वदिष्यामि । तन्मामवतु । तद्वक्तारमवतु ॥
ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः ॥
documents.transliteration:
oṃ namo brahmaṇe | namaste vāyo |
tvameva pratyakṣaṃ brahmāsi | tvāmeva pratyakṣaṃ brahma vadiṣyāmi |
ṛtaṃ vadiṣyāmi | satyaṃ vadiṣyāmi | tanmāmavatu | tadvaktāramavatu ||
oṃ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ ||
documents.text:
Salutation to Brahman! Salutation to Thee, O Vāyu (Cosmic Life Breath)!
Thou indeed art the perceptible Brahman. I shall declare Thee as the perceptible Brahman.
I shall speak the eternal Law (Ṛtam); I shall speak the absolute Truth (Satyam). May That protect me; may That protect the teacher.
Om Peace, Peace, Peace.

documents.original:
ॐ ॐ ॐ ।
ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः ॥
documents.transliteration:
oṃ oṃ oṃ |
oṃ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ ||
documents.text:
Om is the primordial sound of the Divine Cosmic Reality.
May peace reign in the physical world (Ādhibhautika), the mental-subtle realm (Ādhidaivika), and the spiritual-causal core of the Self (Ādhyātmika).

documents.original:
ॐ भूर्भुवः स्वः ।
तत्सवितुर्वरेण्यं भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि ।
धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात् ॥
documents.transliteration:
oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ |
tatsaviturvareṇyaṃ bhargo devasya dhīmahi |
dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt ||

documents.original: सर्वदेवात्मको ह्येष तेजस्वी रश्मिभावनः। एष देवासुरगणांल्लोकान् पाति गभस्तिभिः॥
documents.transliteration: Sarva-devatmako hy esha tejasvi rashmi-bhavanah. Esha devasura-ganaml lokan pati gabhastibhih.
documents.text: Indeed, this Sun embodies all deities; he is radiant, the creator of the rays. With his illuminating rays, he sustains the celestial beings, the titans, and all mortal worlds.

documents.original: त्र्यम्बकं यजामहे सुगन्धिं पुष्टिवर्धनम्। उर्वारुकमिव बन्धनान्मृत्योर्मुक्षीय माऽमृतात्॥
documents.transliteration: Tryambakam yajamahe sugandhim pushti-vardhanam. Urvarukam iva bandhanan mrityor mukshiya ma amritat.
documents.text: We revere the Three-Eyed Lord (Shiva), the fragrant one who nourishes and sustains all life. May He liberate us from the bondage of mortality and cyclic death, as effortlessly as a ripe cucumber is severed from its vine, but never from immortality.

documents.original: जटाटवीगलज्जलप्रवाहपावितस्थले गलेऽवलम्ब्य लम्बितां भुजङ्गतुङ्गमालिकाम्।
documents.transliteration: Jatata-vigalaj-jala-pravaha-pavita-sthale gale avalambya lambitam bhujanga-tunga-malikam.
documents.text: With his neck consecrated by the sacred flow of water trickling down from his dense forest of matted locks, and adorned with the lofty garland of the serpent king coiled around his throat, Lord Shiva performs his cosmic dance.

documents.original: जय हनुमान ज्ञान गुन सागर। जय कपीस तिहुँ लोक उजागर॥
documents.transliteration: Jaya Hanumana jnana guna sagara. Jaya kapisa tihu loka ujagara.
documents.text: Hail to Lord Hanuman, the boundless ocean of wisdom and virtues! Hail to the sovereign of monkey warriors, whose glory illuminates all three worlds.
